title: Shinchan and the Great School-Fair Switcheroo
description: Three records disagree about the family entrance, check-in, and wristband. Import Shinchan’s missing access note, connect the evidence, then submit the full plan.
question: For Futaba Kindergarten's family science fair on November 7, which entrance, check-in time, and wristband should our family use, what does the accessible-route note say, and what detail still needs confirmation?
context: FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE — the kindergarten, fair, dates, people, directions and records are invented for this game. Start with the three records in the locker. Download and upload Shinchan’s bonus access update, then run the patrol. The accessible drop-off and parking detail is intentionally left unresolved.

requirements.label: Accessible parking or drop-off details
support_patterns: accessible vehicle drop off is located
requirements.next_action: Ask the fictional event desk whether accessible parking or drop-off is available, where it is located, and who can reserve it.

challenge.opening: Uh-oh! Shinchan found three different school-fair plans. Misae has a flyer, the parent chat has a rumor, and the latest event bulletin may have changed the rules. Find Shinchan’s missing access note before choosing.
challenge.objective: Rebuild one evidence-backed family plan: entrance, check-in, wristband, bus departure and step-free route. Identify what the records still do not tell you.
challenge.final_question: Which complete plan is supported by the reviewed records?

choices.label: Main Gate at 9:00 AM, yellow badge, and assume accessible drop-off is available.
Playground Gate at 9:00 AM, yellow badge, and use the old flyer for the access route.
East Library Gate check-in at 9:20 AM with a blue wristband; the bus leaves Main Gate at 9:35 AM; the step-free ramp opens at 9:15 AM; accessible parking/drop-off is still unconfirmed.
East Library Gate at 9:35 AM with a blue wristband; the ramp opens at 9:15 AM and accessible drop-off is confirmed.

hints: Start with the dates. Which record was issued most recently, and which earlier instructions does it replace?
In the revised bulletin, separate family check-in from bus departure. The access update gives a ramp opening time too.
Compare the exact gate, check-in time, and wristband in the November 5 bulletin. The access update never states parking or drop-off availability.
challenge.hint: Separate the revised check-in instruction from the bus departure, then read the access note’s final sentence carefully.
challenge.resolution: The November 5 organizer bulletin is the latest plan: families check in at East Library Gate at 9:20 AM with blue wristbands; the bus departs from Main Gate at 9:35 AM. The uploaded access update says the step-free ramp opens at East Library Gate at 9:15 AM. None of the reviewed records confirms accessible parking or drop-off, so that detail remains a question for the fictional event desk.

title: Shinchan & the Class-Trip Switcheroo
description: Three trip notices disagree about the gate, check-in time, and wristband. Rebuild the final plan from the dated evidence before the class bus leaves.
question: Which arrival plan should Shinchan's class follow for the November field trip?
context: UNSOLVED CLUB CHALLENGE — all school names, dates, routes, and notices here are fictional. Read the source dates, trace what changed, run the clue patrol, then submit your final plan in Mission Board.

challenge.opening: The class trip is tomorrow and the parent chat has three different plans. Shinchan has one bus and one very confused class.
challenge.objective: Choose the correct check-in gate, arrival time, and wristband from the latest trip-day instructions.
challenge.final_question: What exact plan should the family follow?

choices.label: North Playground Gate at 9:00 AM with a yellow wristband.
Main School Gate at 9:15 AM with a green name tag.
East Library Gate at 9:20 AM with a blue wristband.
East Library Gate at 9:35 AM with a blue wristband.

challenge.hint: Separate check-in time from bus departure, and compare the dated route card with the older flyers.
challenge.resolution: The signed route card is the latest trip-day instruction: check in at the East Library Gate at 9:20 AM with a blue wristband. The bus leaves at 9:35 AM. The North Playground Gate is closed, while the Main Gate is only for bus loading.

title: Shiro's Lost-Bell Trail
description: A tiny red bell vanished during Shiro's park walk. Reconstruct the route, follow the handoff, and find the claim tag that identifies the right item.
question: Where is Shiro's bell now, and what claim tag should the Noharas give the attendant?
context: UNSOLVED CLUB CHALLENGE — the park, people, timestamps, and lost-property log are fictional. Use the timeline and exact tag details to decide where Shinchan should look first.

challenge.opening: Shiro's red bell jingled all through the park walk, then vanished before lunch. Three helpers remember different places. Follow the pawprints and the handoff.
challenge.objective: Use the walk log, volunteer notes, and lost-property record to identify the bell's current location and its claim tag.
challenge.final_question: Where should Shinchan check first, and which tag proves the bell is Shiro's?

choices.label: Search the flowerbed beside the Pond Gate; no claim tag is needed.
Search under the covered West Fountain bench; tell staff it is a red bell.
Ask at the Gate Office, Lost Property Drawer B, using tag SB-17.
Check the picnic-lawn lost-and-found bin using tag W-14.

challenge.hint: One record tells you where the bell was spotted; the later log tells you where staff moved it and records its tag.
challenge.resolution: The volunteer saw the bell near the West Fountain bench, but the lost-property log records the later handoff: it was moved to the Gate Office, Lost Property Drawer B. The item is tagged SB-17, which matches Shiro's collar note. W-14 is a route marker, not the bell's claim tag.

title: Action Kamen's Showtime Switcheroo
description: The hero-festival poster, venue note, and stage run sheet disagree. Separate guest check-in from performance time and find the final entrance and wristband.
question: What plan gets Shinchan to the right entrance for Action Kamen's festival performance?
context: UNSOLVED CLUB CHALLENGE — this hero festival and every schedule are fictional. Read the document versions carefully: doors, guest check-in, and stage time are different clues.
jurisdiction: Fictional Hero Festival at Sunshine Hall

challenge.opening: Action Kamen is coming to the hero festival! Shinchan found three schedules, two entrances, and a suspicious number of wristbands.
challenge.objective: Build a reliable arrival plan by separating guest check-in, the stage performance, entrance, and wristband.
challenge.final_question: Which plan matches the latest signed festival instructions?

North Entrance at 6:10 PM with a silver pass, performance at 6:35 PM.
South Lobby check-in at 6:10 PM with a blue wristband; performance at 6:40 PM.
South Lobby at 6:40 PM with a blue wristband; that is when guest check-in begins.

challenge.resolution: The signed run sheet is the latest source. Guests check in at the South Lobby at 6:10 PM with a blue wristband. Action Kamen's performance starts at 6:40 PM. The 6:00 PM time is the original show opening, and the North Entrance is closed for the event.
